DocDigest.description: The 64-bit FNV-1a of the document's body as compact JSON, as 16 lowercase hex digits.

Name.description: A name in the project: lowercase letters and digits, words joined by single hyphens, such as wayfaring or blood-sport-v2.

description: The body of a journal entry whose `event` is snapshot.taken and whose `v` is 1.0.

digest.description:
The digest of what it froze: the body of the snapshot's own `snapshot.duet`, which
states the digest of every file it copied.

name.description: The song's name, its folder's, when the snapshot was taken.

snapshot.description: The snapshot's name, its folder's under the song's `snapshots/`.

song.description: The song's stable id, as its `song.duet` states it.

title: duet journal event snapshot.taken 1.0
